summary_en: This Phase 2 study compares elacestrant alone with elacestrant plus a CDK4/6 inhibitor in people with ER-positive, HER2-negative advanced or metastatic breast cancer who had prior CDK4/6 inhibitor treatment. Elacestrant is taken by mouth once a day in 28-day cycles, repeated until the disease progresses. In the combination arm, palbociclib or ribociclib is taken for 21 of every 28 days, or abemaciclib is taken twice a day. The main outcome is not stated; the study is a randomized Phase 2 trial.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 compara elacestrant solo con elacestrant más un inhibidor de CDK4/6 en personas con cáncer de mama avanzado o metastásico, positivo para receptor de estrógeno y negativo para HER2, que ya habían recibido un inhibidor de CDK4/6. El elacestrant se toma por vía oral una vez al día en ciclos de 28 días, que se repiten hasta que la enfermedad progresa. En el grupo de combinación, el palbociclib o el ribociclib se toman durante 21 de cada 28 días, o el abemaciclib se toma dos veces al día. El desenlace principal no está indicado en el registro; el estudio es un ensayo aleatorizado de fase 2.
who_for: ER-positive and HER2-negative breast cancer confirmed by tests
At least one measurable lesion, or a mainly lytic bone lesion that meets the stated criteria
At least 2 prior endocrine therapies, including a CDK4/6 inhibitor in the metastatic setting
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 0 or 1
not_for: Chemotherapy or radiotherapy within 28 days before registration (6 weeks for nitrosoureas or mitomycin C)
Brain metastases, except stable, treated ones that meet the stated conditions
Documented pneumonitis or interstitial lung disease before registration
Taking strong or moderate CYP3A4 inducers or inhibitors
